thread:
elena: Thanks everyone for joining the all-hands today. Quick follow-ups from the Q&A on compliance and security — SOC2/ISO timelines, VPC/private control plane, audit log retention/streaming, and KMS/BYOK. Drop questions here and we'll route to owners.

matt: Timeline question — are we still aiming for SOC2 Type II this year?

aya: Short answer: yes. We have SOC2 Type I completed (May), Type II audit window is planned for Mar–Jun; expecting report by end of Q3. ISO 27001 is scoped and target is next year. I'll share exact dates once the auditor confirms.

ryan: Clarify VPC setup: can customers host the control plane in their own VPC or only the data plane?

aya: Data plane: yes, Private deployments run in-customer VPC (customer-managed subnets/ENIs). Control plane: currently Redwood-managed but supports private connectivity options (AWS PrivateLink, VPC peering) and strict network allow-lists. For fully air-gapped/offline on-prem installs we offer a packaged control-plane option (customer hosts both). We'll add a topology diagram to infra docs.

chris: KMS/BYOK question: do we support external HSMs or only cloud KMS providers? E.g., AWS KMS vs CloudHSM vs Azure KeyVault.

aya: We support AWS KMS and GCP KMS for BYOK today; Azure KeyVault is on the roadmap. We use envelope encryption with your CMK; Redwood never has access to your plaintext master key. Full external HSM integration (PKCS#11 direct HSM ops) is currently a pilot with one customer — GA depends on demand and compliance requirements.

sam: About audit logs: what retention options do we offer, formats, and can customers stream logs to their S3 or SIEM? Also how does PII redaction work?

eli: Audit logs can be exported in JSONL and NDJSON formats. Default retention is 90 days; enterprise customers can configure retention up to 7 years (add-on). We support streaming/export to customer S3 buckets and to Kafka/Splunk via connectors. For PII, we offer configurable redaction and field-level masking rules in the Console; redaction happens before export/export hooks. Example export config snippet:```json
{
  "export": "s3://my-org-redwood-audit/",
  "format": "ndjson",
  "redact_fields": ["request_body.user_email", "request_body.credit_card"]
}```

maria: Who owns SLA credit / contract language for breaches or incident-related credits?

lawrence: Legal here — we have standard incident and SLA clauses in our enterprise playbook. For bespoke contracts we negotiate indemnity and credit language with Sales + Legal. Incident notifications follow our IR playbook; we provide timelines and a post-incident report. For contract-specific questions, loop in enterprise-sales@redwood.com.

elena: Action items from this thread: (1) @aya to publish SOC2/ISO timeline doc and auditor contacts; (2) eng-infra to upload a VPC/control-plane topology diagram and Private deployment checklist; (3) security to publish current KMS/BYOK provider guide and BYOK onboarding flow; (4) ops to document audit-log streaming setup and retention options. We'll post links once artifacts are live.

aya: Noted — I’ll drop the timeline + a short FAQ by EOD. :memo:

chris: If anyone wants to join the BYOK/HSM pilot or has specific compliance constraints, reply here and we’ll coordinate.

elena: Thanks everyone. If there are follow-ups that need leadership input, tag me or DM. We’ll keep this thread as the canonical place for deliverables and links. :white_check_mark:
